BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

6. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   C. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Financial Regulators in Business; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
